blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS Live Captions (visionOS 26 / iOS 26 Live Captions & visionOS Dictation): Centered over true live passthrough world with saturate 1.6 blur 28-34 + rim light, not synthetic gradient. Top bar hides until gaze — only one pill Live 28h 999r rgba0,0,0 0.42 blur10 with 7px pulsing accent dot + tabular timer 11/700 dot ok, language is implicit per speaker not duplicated pill. Transcript is single-hero focus: ONE current line at a time centered 658w with 16r glass, left 3px accent bar glow 10px, current word highlighted with 6r wash 0.16 + 0.18 stroke + 10px glow, previous lines dim to 0.42 opacity and scale 0.98 with blur falloff, no second equal card. Text is 15/600 ink-100 1.45 with 2-line clamp max, speaker pill 11/800 uppercase only for MARA vs You grey 0.12, time 11 tabular ink-60, confidence is thin 3px line with gradient 0.07 only on current. Waveform is single centered pill 48w 14h with 3 bars subtly reacting 200ms prism-ease, not 12-bar marching. Controls hide until gaze near: pause is single 44 primary gradient bloom persisting as hero, mute is ghost until hover. Motion 220-280ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) interruptible spring, blurWipe 260ms per word interruptible by look-away reverse 180ms, no infinite 1.4s pulse nor 900ms caret blink. Typography 3 sizes max: 15 body / 11 meta / 10 caption, tabular only on timer, no duplicate English labels, hint is single 10 0.06em dimmed Wave reacts hidden. Edge states are native sheets over passthrough with one 64 illustration + one CTA + caption, no skeleton web list. Glance <0.9s: live word → done.
blindDescriptions.System B: Horizon OS Captions (Quest 3 Horizon Home / Live Captions v74): Flat opaque panel #1e1e1e 12r, 1px #333 border, shadow 8px, no backdrop-filter. Stage is solid dark #121418 no radial wash, no blur glass. Header is 44h opaque bar Captions 16/700 left + 11/600 battery 82% right + divider, pills flat grey 28r 11/600 no blur. Transcript is full-width vertical list of 5 flat cards 12r #2a2a2a fill 1px #333, each card title 14 medium, body 13 regular, time 12 tabular but 4 equal weights, speaker tags flat grey MARA/YOU same grey chip 11/600, no left accent bar, no highlight, current word is bold but not washed. Waveform is 12 flat grey bars 3px with linear 400ms fade, not reacting to voice. Controls: mute + pause are flat grey circles 36 with 1px stroke, no primary hierarchy, copy/clear are flat 28r grey equal weight. Hint is 10/600 'Gaze + dwell' but cramped. Motion linear 350-500ms slide with 20px overshoot bounce, word reveal is instant no blur, caret is static pipe. Edge states: empty is centered text 'No captions' 16/600 no illustration, loading is spinner + Loading... 14/500 centered, error is red text 'Something wrong' + Retry flat grey, offline is snackbar 'Offline queuing' overlapping list, permission is system opaque dialog Allow/Not now with 1px border. No tabular beyond time, no reduce-motion sheet scan, focus is weak 1px blue ring competing across 6 cards. Glance needs ~2.8s, no hero.
